body:
## [3.107.0] - 2026-11-08

### Features

- add optional 70/30 payment action row (AION-730)

### Bug Fixes

- fall back to catalog prices after coverage recovery
- recover missing pricing data silently
- keep checkout pricing recovery silent
- scope pricing recovery to the current cart and customer
- preserve trace IDs in exported logs
- recover from unavailable pricelist coverage
- silently recover with verified draft prices
- recover checkout from stalled repricing
- preserve POS redemptions and correct discounted earnings (AION-741)
- keep checkout ready on the same pricelist

### Other Changes

- override the popup search provider in widget fixtures
- trace customer creation and follow-up refreshes
- Implemented the customer popup search: - Searches the local database first. - If no match exists, searches Odoo. - Saves matching customers locally and displays them for selection.
- batch checkout diagnostics outside SQLite
- trace checkout readiness and refresh timing
- AION-750: Auto-close PayTag dialog after successful neutralization
- Made the Z-table text bold, keeping the same font size.
- in z report the name of session shoulb be present in one line , not complete name in next line
- Updated both consolidated printing and on-screen preview: - Header omits the Z number. - Business period uses the selected date range. - Table lists every Z: number, opened, closed, amount. - Department and payment totals remain consolidated. - GT counters, average sale, and transaction counts are omitted.
- mplemented the consolidated Z report option. - Added “Show consolidated report” / “הצג דוח מרוכז”, unchecked by default. - Consolidated mode shows one row with the first opening, last closing, and summed amount, without a Z number. - Preview and printing use the existing POS printer flow.
